description: This is a Swift source file defining a SwiftUI View called `GeneralSettings`. It manages the user interface for adjusting application settings related to network connections, gateway management, health monitoring, and other app configurations within a macOS application.

classes.name: GeneralSettings
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that provides a comprehensive interface for app configuration, including gateway management, remote connection settings, health status, and toggle options for various features.

methods.name: refreshGatewayStatus
methods.description: Asynchronously checks the current environment status of the gateway and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: testRemote
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous remote gateway probe to verify remote connection parameters and updates the remote status display.

methods.name: revealLogs
methods.description: Opens the application logs in the system file viewer or shows an alert if logs are unavailable.

methods.name: applyDiscoveredGateway
methods.description: Applies the selected discovered gateway to the app's configuration, typically setting it as the preferred gateway.
